issues: Covers rose by 108 week on week (+12.12%) while spend per head fell by £0.53 (-2.46%).
Sales were up £2,212.70 week on week (+10.07%) but £2,832.77 behind target (-10.49%).
Labour, budget rota, operational F/R and food and drinks variance were left blank in the report.
Intangibles, staff updates and hiring were reported as N/A, and no maintenance jobs were logged.
The site ran out of chicken, beef and dynamite prawns on Sunday, and guests left because of it.
Katsu and karaage order quantities were entered the wrong way round, causing the chicken shortage.
Sunday stock outs recur because orders are placed on Sunday instead of Friday, so deliveries arrive on Wednesday; the fixed Thursday JFC delivery is also a constraint.
Two boxes of chicken are being borrowed from Nottingham to cover the shortage.
Deliveroo refunds were recovered using photographic evidence, except one genuine error where chocolate was sent instead of strawberry.
A Saturday kitchen backlog formed when a chef was on break during a sudden rush, and food quality and presentation slipped.
Bad reviews included a chicken ramen made with vegetable broth instead of chicken broth, and long serving times.
On the Sunday visit the pork broth was too light and the chicken broth slightly salty, and the veggie broth looked too clear and watery rather than dark green.
Staff are demotivated about asking for Google reviews because guests are not leaving them.
The rota tool formulas have been deleted, so it is not updating.
The sushi lead leaves next Wednesday at short notice.
A hot kitchen chef who can cut fish and make sushi has asked to cross train on sushi specs.
A sushi chef from a nearby restaurant, referred via Zula, is interested in joining.
The head chef and another team member are due to leave in December and January, raising winter staffing risk.
A front of house trial shift is booked for Friday, and part time front of house hiring is under way.
A former team member has returned and needs no training, and another team member has left.
A broken freezer and old chairs and tables need collecting, and new chairs and tables have been ordered; the heavy old motors need a heavy duty collection service.
The student festival sign up event was cut short by a fire alarm.
Highcross extends opening on student nights, but the site will keep its 9pm last order and use vouchers to bring students back.
KPI notes are missing from the Drive.
The Deliveroo and Slurp discount promotion with a scratch card and a can of Coke in every bag is due to start on 12/10.
